extraction.Name: Louis McGhee
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded December 7, 1918, by O. L. Dice
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged the land to W. H. Tackett for $500; on May 14, 1919, he and his wife conveyed the land by deed to W. H. Tackett for $1000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612779; Southeast quarter section 20, township 36, north of range 22; receipt for patent signed by allottee but not dated; document also references William McGhee, Allotment No. 7792, Fee patent No. 612780, Southeast quarter section 19, township 36, north of range 32, issued December 29, 1917, receipt signed by allottee but not dated, recorded by C. L. Dice June 28, 1919, McGhee deeded the land to W. H. Tackett for $1000 on July 8, 1919
